preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of different types of ingredients N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= A_i <= 10**4 for A_i in map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the quantity of each ingredient A_i is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 if any(A_i < 2 for A_i in map(int, input().split())) else return_value[i] == sum(A_i - 2 for A_i in map(int, input().split())) + 2 * N for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if any ingredient quantity is less than 2, the output is -1. Otherwise, the output is the sum of (A_i - 2) for all ingredients plus 2 times the number of ingredients N.
